Test Case Description: Verify generic success message when submitting email not in system (security best practice)
PreRequisites:
- Email 'notexist@test.com' does not exist in NGUOIDUNG table
- Forgot password page is accessible
Test Case Expected Result: System shows generic success message without revealing whether email exists (prevents email enumeration attack).

Step Expected Result:
- Generic success message: 'Nếu email tồn tại trong hệ thống, bạn sẽ nhận được link đặt lại mật khẩu'
- No email is actually sent (email doesn't exist)
- No error revealing email doesn't exist
- User cannot tell if email is valid or not
- Prevents attackers from discovering valid emails
